en.intro: Since many of my friends know me for my extensive knowledge of trivia and quirky facts, I decided to include some in my portfolio. Most of them come with a source link, so you can check them yourself.
en.start: Click one of the buttons above to see a fun fact!

cz.unknown: Zajímavosti, o kterých jste asi neslyšeli
